rule.description: Reports a method (Pylint message E9901) whose body embeds the implementations of the sub-methods it should delegate to. Absorption is measured with a normalized statement-shape longest common subsequence between the method body and each helper body reachable in the project call graph (names erased, call targets and constants kept, return statements excluded as delegation interface). A helper counts as absorbed with >=3 matched statements at >=0.75 coverage; the relation is reported when >=2 distinct helpers are absorbed, their matched statements total >=12, the method is thereby oversized, and at least one absorbed helper itself delegates to another absorbed helper, i.e. the collapse spans multiple levels of the original hierarchy. Any repair that delegates again - to the original helpers or to newly extracted, well-scoped sub-methods - removes the message.

checks.description: Detect a training step that absorbs the per-batch target-construction hierarchy: the proposal-target creator's orchestration, the anchor-target chain label-assignment -> IoU matching -> encode/overlap leaves.
checks.detected_relation: FasterRCNNTrainer.forward -> embedded bodies of [ProposalTargetCreator.__call__ -> bbox_iou & bbox2loc; AnchorTargetCreator._create_label -> _calc_ious -> bbox_iou, and bbox2loc]
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The method copies the implementations of the units that own target assignment and sampling instead of delegating to them: the creator -> _create_label -> _calc_ious -> bbox_iou/bbox2loc chain is collapsed into one oversized body, and the same overlap and encode math now exists twice inside it under different name prefixes while the original units remain in place.

matches.evidence: Body embeds the proposal-target creator's __call__ orchestration (roi concatenation with ground truth, second IoU under sample_*-prefixed locals, positive/negative sampling draws, background +1 offset, loc-normalize-std division), the anchor-target chain (label initialization, threshold labelling with configuration read through local creator aliases, per-gt argmax fix-up loop, pos/neg subsampling), two broadcasted bbox_iou copies (ious_* and sample_* locals) and two bbox2loc copies for the regression deltas, with the empty-ground-truth handling absorbed as an explicit if/else.

checks.description: Detect a proposal forward that absorbs grid enumeration and the per-image proposal-filtering unit together with the region decode that unit should call.
checks.detected_relation: RegionProposalNetwork.forward -> embedded bodies of [ProposalCreator.__call__; _enumerate_shifted_anchor; ProposalCreator.__call__ -> loc2bbox]
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The network forward re-derives anchor-grid enumeration and the whole decode/filter/sort/NMS/pad pipeline owned by the proposal unit instead of delegating, and the absorbed unit's own decode helper is inlined one level deeper, so multiple hierarchy levels are collapsed inside a per-image loop.

matches.evidence: Anchor tensor built inline (meshgrid shifts, np.stack, base-plus-shift broadcast, astype) with feat_stride/anchor_base hoisted to locals; per-image block embeds the proposal-creator body (mode branch, tensor conversion, edge clamping, min-size filter scaled per image, score sorting with pre-NMS truncation, torchvision NMS, random padding draw, post-NMS slice) with per-image *_t locals and a local creator alias, plus a full inline expansion of the region decode with an auxiliary zero-source if/else.

checks.description: Detect an evaluation routine that absorbs the per-image evaluation driver and, through it, the decode unit's hierarchy (decode -> region decode) plus the shared preprocessing and correction helpers.
checks.detected_relation: EvalCallback.get_map_txt -> embedded bodies of [FasterRCNN.get_map_txt -> DecodeBox.forward -> loc2bbox; get_new_img_size; cvtColor; frcnn_correct_boxes]
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The callback copies the implementations of the evaluation driver's helper chain - sizing, color conversion, decode, per-class threshold/NMS and scale correction - into its own body, collapsing a three-tier pipeline whose originals remain in use by the prediction path, so the same knowledge is second-sourced.

matches.evidence: Short-edge sizing computed inline with a hoisted img_min_side local; color-conversion guard, resize and normalization inline (module-level imports of torch.nn.functional and torchvision.ops nms added to serve the embedded copies); decode-unit body copied with std/num_classes read through a bbox_util alias, region decode expanded with its zero-source if/else, per-class confidence threshold, NMS and label stacking; box-to-image-space correction arithmetic inlined with input_shape/image_shape rebound to arrays inside the fragment.

checks.description: Detect a dataset item accessor that absorbs the class's own shared loading/augmentation method including its color-conversion helper.
checks.detected_relation: FRCNNDataset.__getitem__ -> embedded bodies of [FRCNNDataset.get_random_data; get_random_data -> cvtColor]
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The accessor embeds the shared preprocessing method it should delegate to (parameter defaults bound to locals, color-conversion protection rewritten inline, letterbox branch, box adjustment, duplicated assembly tail per branch), so the dataloading contract is maintained in two competing places on the same class.

matches.evidence: Helper's adaptive parameters (jitter/hue/sat/val) bound to locals at entry; image opened with the color-conversion protection rewritten as a pass/else; non-random letterbox branch and box adjustment inlined with the assembly tail (box padding, box/label slicing, return) duplicated per branch; the original get_random_data and cvtColor remain in place on the same class.

excluded.reason: Similar in shape to the network's per-image evaluation driver but does not absorb a multi-level sub-method hierarchy: it delegates to the decode unit and image helpers instead of copying them, so it stays below the rule's multi-helper and hierarchy-edge requirements and is not part of this case.
Long assignment/plotting blocks with no delegation absorbed; repetitive code is not the inlined-sub-method relation.
Delegates to the trainer and creators without copying implementations; contains no embedded helper body.
Module-level contract function with no sub-methods to absorb.
